scorecard.rationale: Oat-containing animal and human interventions used combined products and tissue or global motor outcomes. Cooked oats and rigidity severity remain untested in the retrieved records. The microbiome review offers oats as a generic prebiotic source. It contains no cooked-oats rigidity result that could support a change in direction. The oat review concerns oat-derived avenanthramides and experimental outcomes. There is no clinical rigidity comparison after eating cooked oats.
